# Test static HTML index file generation

# Test generating static HTML with custom index
md2html -html output -index INDEX.md
exists output/index.html
grep -q 'Welcome to Documentation' output/index.html

# Without -index, README.md is the site index, as the server serves it.
# It is still written as README.html, so links to it keep working.
rm -rf output
md2html -html output
grep -q 'Main Project README' output/index.html
! grep -q 'Index of /' output/index.html
grep -q 'Main Project README' output/README.html

# A lowercase readme.md is used the same way
rm -rf output
mv README.md readme.md
md2html -html output
grep -q 'Main Project README' output/index.html
! grep -q 'Index of /' output/index.html

# With neither an index.md nor a README, the index is a listing
rm -rf output
rm INDEX.md readme.md
md2html -html output
exists output/index.html
grep -q 'Index of /' output/index.html

# An index.md is the site index; no listing replaces it
rm -rf output
cp guide.md index.md
md2html -html output
grep -q 'Complete user guide content' output/index.html
! grep -q 'Index of /' output/index.html

# An index.md wins over a README.md, as it does in the server
rm -rf output
cp api.md README.md
md2html -html output
grep -q 'Complete user guide content' output/index.html
grep -q 'API documentation here' output/README.html

# Clean up
rm -rf output

-- INDEX.md --
---
title: Documentation Index
author: Test Author
---

# Welcome to Documentation

This is the custom index file.

## Quick Links

- [Guide](guide.md)
- [API](api.md)

-- README.md --
# Main Project README

This is the main README that becomes index.html

## Installation

Install instructions here.

-- guide.md --
# User Guide

Complete user guide content.

-- api.md --
# API Reference

API documentation here.
